name: ICT Incident Response Plan
content:
Section 7.2 Regulatory notification. Where an incident is classified as major under the incident classification standard, the Regulatory Affairs Manager shall submit the initial notification to the competent authority within 24 hours of classification. The incident management tooling is configured to escalate at the 24 hour mark.

Section 7.3 Records. The notification timestamp is recorded on the incident ticket.

name: AML and Sanctions Policy
content: Section 4 Screening. Every counterparty is screened before the first payment is executed.

name: Access Management Policy
content: Section 6.3 Access is revoked within one business day of a leaver's final working day. Section 6.7 Privileged accounts dormant for 90 days are disabled.

name: Change Management Standard
content:
Section 5.1 Every change merged to a production branch carries an approval recorded by a person other than its author.
Section 5.4 Emergency changes may be merged without prior approval where an emergency change ticket exists in the CHG project and is approved retrospectively within five business days. Such a change is not a control exception.

name: Outsourcing and Third Party Risk Policy
content: Section 3 Critical providers require current due diligence and a documented exit strategy.

name: Payments Authorisation Policy
content: Section 4.1 Payment instructions of EUR 50,000 or more require two independent authorisers.

name: Policy Governance Standard
content: Section 3 Every board-mandated policy is reviewed within its stated cycle.
